crossRefs.note: It was so, that after Yahweh had spoken these words to Job, Yahweh said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled…
Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a…
You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you…
“Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
“How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?”
But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

translations.web: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.
translations.bsb: Surely He would rebuke you if you secretly showed partiality.
translations.kjv: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
translations.asv: He will surely reprove you If ye do secretly show partiality.
